title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=x^2$$ would affect the shape of the data when applied to the x-values. Does the pattern suggest a quadratic relationship?

title: Analyzing Quadratic Fit
text: If $$f(x)=x^2$$, the model becomes $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+{x_i}^2 \beta_2$$. Does this form match the linear pattern observed in the scatterplot?
